mtp-web

Browser demo

Connect a phone in File Transfer mode, then browse, download, upload and delete objects over WebUSB.

Works in Chromium browsers over HTTPS. Select the phone in the browser picker.

mtp-web on GitHub · Usage guide

Connection

Not connected

The browser opens a device picker. Select the phone and allow access.

Unlock the phone and set the USB mode to File Transfer / MTP. Close Android File Transfer and adb first. The page does not send data to a server.
